items.title: Tony Fougerat Interview, 1960-06-08
items.q: While it was Buddy P. Teague.

ctx.x: You talked about Rene, and you were saying how good he was.

Yeah, Rene was... I remember Rene. When I was a young kid, I would just start, like I told you, I played in one key. And that was the trumpet player that I followed around the streets. Every time I'd see Rene, he was on some wagon playing for the fights or something like that. And they used to go from corner to corner. And there was one particular tune that I heard him play. And I liked that tune so well that I played that tune today myself. And every time I played, I always think about it Rene because he played…
